FFmpeg in Memories Rescue
=========================

Memories Rescue uses FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) to add overlays to videos,
convert videos to H.264 and join clips. FFmpeg is licensed under the GNU
Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later (LGPL v2.1+); the full
text is in the file COPYING.LGPLv2.1 next to this notice.

This copy of FFmpeg is version 9.0.2, built by NovaByteWorks with only the
parts Memories Rescue needs. It is a separate program (ffmpeg.exe on
Windows, ffmpeg on macOS) in the application folder; Memories Rescue starts
it and does not link it into itself. You are free to replace it with your
own build of FFmpeg.

Source code. The complete corresponding source for the FFmpeg we ship (the
unmodified upstream release ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz, SHA-256
8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e), the build
script and the exact configure options are published with each release at

    https://github.com/arbaaz360/memories-rescue-releases

under the folder for that release (ffmpeg/). If you cannot get it there,
write to NovaByteWorks through the contact address on
https://novabyteworks.com and we will send it to you for no more than the
cost of sending it. This offer is valid for at least three years after we
last distribute this version.

FFmpeg is a trademark of Fabrice Bellard, originator of the FFmpeg project.
Memories Rescue is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FFmpeg project.
